ns2:course.label: Undergraduate Open Seminar
ns2:course.description: An experimental course on a special topic in agricultural leadership, education and communications. May be repeated in the same or separate terms as topics vary to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: ALEC Program approval required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated in the same or separate terms as topics vary to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: ALEC Program approval required.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agricultural Education concentration(s). Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
